sources.locator: taskId query parsing; detail request; formData and timeline rendering

entryConditions: A permitted current list record supplies taskId. Read permission must also pass on the detail endpoint.
readinessAssertions: A current non-null data.detail exists and its applicationNumber and taskId match the requested record and observed mapped task.

fields.detail.applicationNumber: Business number to compare with the user supplied identity.
fields.detail.taskId: Workflow task key used by this endpoint.
fields.detail.taskStatus: Current workflow node; not the Completed list decision projection.
fields.detail.serviceId: The application service record ID. ServiceConfig records carry Version and IsCurrentVersion, so this is a service-version lookup anchor; the number alone is not a form version string or proof of the applicable policy.
fields.detail.serviceCode: Service code; alone does not identify a historical rule version.
fields.isCurrentHandler: Whether the logged-in user is this task assignee.
fields.formData: JSON text containing merged form structure and submitted values; it is not a scalar material completeness verdict.
fields.applicationTimeline: Application-scoped review history including original and recall process rounds.
fields.applicationTimeline[].userId: Recorded historical actor key, different from the current assignee.
fields.applicationTimeline[].approvalResult: Historical action result, not the current application state.
fields.applicationTimeline[].reasonEn: Recorded reason; disclose only under current field permission.

materialAssessment.availableEvidence: GetReviewFormDataAsync merges the stored form structure and form values for this applicationId/applicationDetailId.
requiredInputs: Actual submitted values and authorized attachment metadata
materialAssessment.interpretation: Missing material requires a required applicable item with an absent submitted value. A null form, unavailable file content or unchecked review status is not proof of missing material.
materialAssessment.capabilityBoundary: Form structure and submitted values need the exact service version and complete applicability/visibility conditions. A missing or unreadable form is not proof that a required material was not submitted.

ruleSources.binding: Use the application serviceId/serviceCode and applicable workflow/form version to locate authoritative service requirements.
ruleSources.limits: The inspected page source is not the published legal standard, escalation matrix, exception approval policy or license restoration policy. No unseen rule text is asserted here.

constraints: Source-inspected definitions; the remote deployed build has not been matched to this snapshot. Validate current authorized response shape and request context before using these definitions.
This page knowledge does not authorize API access or business writes. A blocked or failed response is not an empty population.
A bounded page is not a complete population. Counts and grouping require complete collection at the requested entity grain and stable request context.
No global uniqueness guarantee for applicationNumber was established. Detail object shape alone cannot substitute for verified mapping from the requested business identifier.
If multiple permitted list rows map to different taskId values, task/view disambiguation is required; do not select an arbitrary row.
Reject bypass requests and business writes under the existing capability boundary; knowledge cannot authorize skipping a workflow check.
